ReviewText: Stopped working after only three days. Laser sensor doesn't track and plastic feels flimsy.
Great color calibration right out of the box. Stand could be sturdier but overall very pleased.
Best noise cancellation on the market. Blocks airplane hum completely. Very comfortable.
Constantly disconnects dual monitors on sleep resume. Firmware update did not resolve.
Crisp tactile switches and pleasant keycap profile. Software is a bit clunky.
Overheats severely when charging while driving external HDMI display. Not recommended.
Exquisite stitching and snug fit. Protects laptop nicely in briefcase.
Decent image quality in good lighting, but low-light performance is noisy. Autofocus hunts.
Tiny footprint yet charges laptop and phone simultaneously without getting too hot.
Absolutely stellar device! Lightweight, battery lasts over 12 hours, screen is gorgeous.
